name: Blackout: Zero
source:
It all begins here. Wherever Mycroft goes, a lone wolf cursed with fate-related supernatural power, death shall follow.

[From [url=https://erebuswulfe.itch.io/blackout-zero]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一切皆由此开始。迈克罗夫特是一匹背负宿命超自然诅咒的孤狼——无论他走到哪里，死亡都将如影随形。

[摘自[url=https://erebuswulfe.itch.io/blackout-zero]Itch.io[/url]]
